run_fastcsp_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config and selected stages
load_config_from_yaml: load and validate a FastCSP workflow configuration from a YAML file using argparse args
detect_workflow_restart: detect if the FastCSP workflow is restarting by checking for an existing log file
generate_crystal_structures: generate putative crystal structures using Genarris as the first stage of the FastCSP workflow
relax_and_filter_structures: relax deduplicated structures with an ML model then filter and rank by energy and density
